author: Dylan Morgan
description: Japan’s Kawasaki Heavy Industries on May 23 announced a partnership with Nvidia to establish a physical AI development center in Silicon Valley. Physical AI refers to AI machines that autonomously perceive, reason, and make decisions in real-world environments, meaning robotics and other autonomous machines. “We would like to make this place a starting point for global […]
title: Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Nvidia Open AI Robotics Center in Silicon Valley
